requirements.text: В списке продуктов отображается домен контактного email поставщика и доступен фильтр продуктов по этому домену.
notes: This slice starts from a successful supplier contact display baseline: Product already has optional supplier_id, supplier_name and supplier_contact_email response/display behavior.
Do not change the Supplier schema. Derive the domain from the existing Supplier.contact_email value when it is present.
The displayed domain must come from the supplier currently assigned to the product, using real supplier ids/contact_email values from the current API or runtime test data.
If the product supplier is changed during edit, the displayed supplier email domain and supplier-domain filter behavior must reflect the newly selected supplier.
